changes.description: Two rings of one unit may meet at a single point, as the OGC simple-features rule allows: a hole touching its outline at one vertex, an island meeting another at a corner. Refusing that refused Quatis and Rio de Janeiro city from geoBoundaries' Brazil, which shapely calls valid. A shared run of edge, or a crossing, is still refused. Experiment 180.
